sourceTitle: Public Art Fund — La Chiffoniere, 1979 exhibition
finding: The original exhibiting organization independently publishes 22 feet. The current scan includes a round base whose inclusion in that measurement is unspecified. Retain the 6.7056 m whole-scan reference as approximate.

Fresh official museum response has no dimension field. The museum uploader describes about 4 cm and a deliberately enlarged VR setting. The latter is not a physical measurement. Retain the approximately 4 cm reference.

Fresh creator description again reports a 50 cm bronze and identifies it only as a probable copy in the manner of Anton Nelson. No independently identified original or institutional measurement was found. Retain the copy-specific estimate.

The municipal sculpture guide confirms Lorieux’s La Chute des feuilles in Parc Jean Rameau but supplies no dimensions. The Centre Pompidou result c5ejzbj is a drawing, not the sculpture. The scan creator’s 140 cm remains approximate.
